title: Sr. Backend Engineer (Remote)
description: Who We Are (Mode.Inc) Mode.Inc is the parent company of a portfolio of technology businesses, including Mode Mobile, the creator of EarnOS, a transformational software platform that turns ordinary smartphones into "EarnPhones". This innovation empowers users worldwide to monetize everyday mobile activities such as streaming, gaming, and shopping. We enable users to profit from their data and attention, rather than letting only tech giants benefit. What sets us apart is our inclusive approach, converting users into earners, facilitating over $150M in earnings and savings, and going a step further by turning earners into owners by awarding stock ownership in Mode.Inc based on their usage. We have attracted over 40 million users across 170 countries. Mode Mobile, Inc. Ranked Number 1 Fastest Growing Company in North America on the 2023 Deloitte Technology Fast 500. For additional insights, check out information about our reward-based super app, Mode Earn App, which also powers the reward engine for our proprietary smartphone, Mode Earn Phone. Our Team and Culture Drive Our Success Our team is the heart of our culture. We value innovation, collaboration, and curiosity, with a passion for getting things done. We strive to hire and cultivate the best team members and foster a culture of open communication and transparency. We are driven and hard-working but also committed to having fun along the way. We allow OKRs to guide us, assume positive intent, sometimes agree to disagree and commit, honor our commitments, seek to accomplish more with less, and encourage everyone to speak up as our team owns our company's success. You can read more about our team and how we work here. The Role Mode.Inc is looking for a Senior Backend Engineer with strong Go expertise to join the team taking ownership of our newly acquired VPN product and the additional apps we will be acquiring. You will help take technical ownership of an existing production VPN following its acquisition by Mode.Inc. Your initial focus will be understanding and stabilizing the existing backend and Go networking engine, closing technical and security gaps, and establishing the engineering foundations needed to evolve the product confidently to a consumer VPN with 10M+ installs, 1,000+ servers in 45+ countries, and users in some of the most restrictive network environments in the world. That engine, a Go library cross-compiled for Android and iOS that embeds a userspace TCP/IP stack and drives the Shadowsocks and WireGuard clients, is the core of the product, and you will be the engineer who understands it, hardens it, and extends it. We are a user-facing product-led team, and we are looking for someone who is passionate about building private, secure, and resilient systems that people depend on every day. As an engineer, you'll be accountable for taking over, stabilizing, and evolving an existing backend: nimbly experimenting with solutions, building high-quality software, and measuring results. You'll own the account, subscription, and server-selection APIs, the WireGuard peer and configuration pipeline, and the integrations with payments, analytics, and attribution providers. You'll establish automated testing, API documentation, and CI/CD where they don't exist yet, close the security gaps identified during due diligence, and use agentic AI coding tools as a core part of your daily workflow. You'll work closely with the mobile frontend engineer, DevOps/network engineer, product managers, operations, and several stakeholders to define and execute according to our strategic roadmap to accelerate our future growth. Who You Are and What You'll Do You are passionate about giving people private, secure, and unrestricted access to the internet. You care about your users and the trust they place in the product. You enjoy inheriting an existing system, reading unfamiliar code, and reverse-engineering how things work, then making them better with tests, documentation, and refactoring. You're an exceptional Go backend engineer with strong networking fundamentals and comfortable across a polyglot backend (Go, Python, Node.js), and you are not afraid to go low-level: raw IP packets, userspace network stacks, proxy and tunnel protocols, and cross-compiling Go for mobile. You design APIs that mobile clients love: clear contracts, versioning, graceful degradation, and documentation (OpenAPI/Swagger) that the frontend team can build against without asking. You embrace agentic AI as a force multiplier: you use AI coding agents to plan, implement, test, and review work, and you know when to trust them and when to verify. You value working closely with Product Management, learning directly from users about what matters to them, and developing solutions that they love. You care deeply about the impact of your work, and measure success by the value added to users' lives: connection success rate, API latency and error rates, and subscription conversion and retention. You're excited to write high-quality, maintainable, and well-tested code that you deliver. You are eager to find minimal ways to test hypotheses and validate feasibility. You're a strong advocate for unit/integration testing and passionate about automated testing and continuously shipping to production. You are security-minded: secrets management, encryption at rest and in transit, cryptographic key generation and handling, least-privilege access, and user privacy are part of everyday engineering, not an afterthought. What You Bring to the Team Must Have: 5+ years of professional senior backend engineering experience in an agile environment delivering services that support native mobile applications, with hands-on production experience using: Go as a primary language: concurrency (goroutines, channels), networking (net, netstack-style packet handling), cgo/gomobile or similar cross-compilation for Android (.aar) and iOS (.framework/XCFramework) Python and Node.js for existing services, scripts, and integrations PostgreSQL (schema design, migrations, performance) and MongoDB or another document store, plus Redis or similar caching AWS: Lambda, S3, RDS, Route 53, IAM, and Docker-based services; familiarity with Terraform/Ansible-managed environments REST API design and documentation (OpenAPI/Swagger), authentication (JWT/OAuth), and rate limiting GitHub for version control and pull-request based workflows; SOLID, Clean Coding, Testing, and CI/CD (GitHub Actions or similar) VPN and networking expertise: working knowledge of WireGuard (peer/key management, configuration generation), Shadowsocks or other proxy/obfuscation protocols, OpenVPN, TCP/IP, DNS, TLS, and how packets flow from a mobile OS tunnel interface through a userspace stack (lwIP, gVisor netstack) to a VPN server. Experience integrating and operating third-party platforms: Stripe and in-app purchase validation (App Store Server API, Google Play Developer API), analytics and attribution (Amplitude, Firebase, AppsFlyer/Adjust or similar), and observability (Datadog). Applied security engineering: secrets management (Vault, AWS Secrets Manager/SSM), encryption of sensitive data at rest, safe cryptographic key generation and storage, dependency and vulnerability scanning, and remediating audit findings. Agentic AI proficiency : demonstrated day-to-day use of AI agents (e.g., Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot agents) to write and review infrastructure code, automate runbooks, and investigate incidents, with strong judgment on verifying AI-generated output before it touches production. You're a candid and empathetic communicator that is excited to join a startup that enjoys leveling up a company. You have exceptional organizational and analytical skills leading to confident independent delivery, but know when and how to include others. You have experience building large-scale systems with some technical leadership skills. Passionate about Technology and keeping up to date with latest advancements, techniques and best practices. Alignment with our Core Values: Accountable: You take ownership of your responsibilities, demonstrating trustworthiness and self-discipline. You are consistent in your work, transparent in your actions, and communicate effectively. You follow through on commitments and strive for continuous improvement. Action-driven: Identify what is most important, agree on scope, timely execute, and drive the greatest impact. You take initiative, roll up your sleeves, and get things done. Caring: You genuinely care about yourself and others, our business and craft, our mission and vision, and are passionate in heart and mind. You understand the importance of our team and strive to create a positive, supportive work environment. Curious: You focus on the 'why,' learn and expand your knowledge, explore new ideas, and generally make things better. You're a lifelong learner with a thirst for knowledge and a constant desire to improve. Thorough: Your work is thoughtful, impactful, timely, accurate, and complete. You pay attention to detail, are meticulous, and ensure quality work and compliance. Nice to Have: (Strongly preferred) Experience building or maintaining a consumer VPN, proxy, or privacy backend, especially censorship-circumvention tooling (Shadowsocks plugins, V2Ray/Xray, obfs4) and server-selection / load-balancing logic across a global fleet (Strongly preferred) Contributions to or deep familiarity with wireguard-go, gVisor netstack, lwIP, or Shadowsocks implementations in Go (Strongly preferred) Experience operating multi-provider infrastructure (AWS plus DigitalOcean, Vultr, Hetzner) and Cloudflare (Strongly preferred) Event-driven and workflow systems (SQS, step functions, job queues) and building resilient integrations with dependency chains and fallbacks Compliance and data-governance experience (GDPR, CCPA, SOC 2), including data retention policies and handling law-enforcement / data requests for a privacy product Kotlin or Swift literacy for pairing with mobile engineers on library integration Experience taking over and integrating acquired products or codebases First 30 days Understand the existing backend and Go networking engine Map critical services, dependencies and data flows Establish local development/debugging workflow Identify highest-risk reliability/security issues Contribute to 100% uptime. 60 days Own meaningful production changes Improve test coverage around critical paths Close priority technical gaps from due diligence Establish better observability/documentation where needed Contribute to 100% uptime. 90 days Independently own backend/VPN-engine initiatives Improve connection reliability / API reliability Reduce operational/manual pain Contribute confidently to product and technical roadmap Contribute to Uptime at world class market levels for similar products. We Believe in the Following Workplace Norms Allow OKRs to Guide Us Assume Positive Intent Agree to Disagree & Commit Set New Precedents Accomplish More with Less Hold Yourself & Others to High Standards Speak Up Be Resourceful Follow the 80/20 Rule What We Are Offering We are a 100% remote-first, global company. A competitive compensation package. We offer generous perks and benefits to team members. Participation in the Company's equity plan (for full-time team members). We provide individual bonuses in accordance with our Company Bonus Program. Work with energetic, passionate, and results-driven people. Celebrate team members' personal and work milestones. Remote social activities, including virtual coffee buddies. Bonusly - We use Bonusly as a way to recognize and reward team members for their hard work and commitment. Weekly Wednesday Get Stuff Done Days (No Meetings). Open PTO, generous Company Holidays, and Wellness Days (for full-time team members). This role is ideal for a results-driven marketing professional with a strong technical background and a keen eye for detail. If you are passionate about digital marketing and investor communications, we encourage you to apply and join a dynamic and innovative team. If we just described you and your perfect role, we'd love to talk with you. We have a lot to accomplish this year and look forward to making headway and creating success together! Mode.Inc does not accept/pay fees for unsolicited resumes from third-party agencies/vendors. Our company is an Equal Employment Opportunity (EEO) employer. We are committed to providing a work environment free of discrimination and harassment. All employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. We celebrate diversity and strive to create an inclusive environment for all team members.

title: Senior Full Stack Engineer
description: About the role We’re looking for a Senior Software Engineer who enjoys working across the stack and building reliable, scalable products. You’ll work on backend services, frontend applications, and the infrastructure that connects them. This is a hands-on engineering role for someone who can take a feature from technical design to production, make pragmatic decisions, and collaborate effectively with product and engineering teams. You’ll be working with modern JVM technologies, React, React Native, AWS, and event-driven systems in a healthcare technology environment where reliability and delivery matter. What you'll do Design, develop, and maintain backend services using Java, Kotlin, or Scala. Build and evolve APIs using REST, gRPC, and GraphQL, including Apollo-based integrations. Develop frontend applications with React, Next.js, and React Native (Expo). Design and implement real-time communication features using WebSockets, event queues, and message brokers. Work with AWS services and contribute to cloud infrastructure and deployment practices. Use Terraform and other infrastructure-as-code tools for basic infrastructure provisioning and management. Improve application observability using tools such as Grafana and Prometheus. Write maintainable, well-tested code and contribute to technical design discussions. Use AI effectively to improve development workflows, from exploration and implementation to testing, debugging, and documentation. Collaborate with product, design, and engineering teams to deliver features on time. Qualifications Strong professional experience as a full-stack software engineer. Solid backend experience with the JVM ecosystem — Java, Kotlin, or Scala. Experience designing and building production-grade APIs with REST, gRPC, and GraphQL. Strong frontend experience with React and Next.js. Experience with React Native, preferably Expo. Experience working with AWS in production environments. Basic experience with Terraform or infrastructure-as-code practices. Experience with real-time systems, event-driven architecture, or message brokers such as SNS/SQS. Familiarity with application monitoring and observability tools such as Grafana and Prometheus. Strong problem-solving skills and a pragmatic approach to engineering decisions. Ability to work independently, communicate clearly, and take ownership of deliverables. Professional working proficiency in English, both written and verbal. A strong interest in using AI efficiently and responsibly in software development. Nice to have Experience in healthcare technology or other highly regulated industries. Experience with distributed systems and asynchronous processing. Experience with CI/CD, containers, and cloud-native deployment practices. Experience contributing to technical architecture and mentoring other engineers. Qualifications Remote-first, full-time, permanent employment in Türkiye. Salary paid in USD, net. Payroll employment with the benefits of a permanent position. Access to our office at ODTÜ Teknokent, Ankara, with regular visits according to planned schedules. 100% private health insurance coverage for the employee. 50% private health insurance coverage for eligible family members, if you choose to include them. Floating vacation days: when a public holiday falls on a weekend, you can take the corresponding day off on a weekday of your choice, subject to applicable policies. The opportunity to work on meaningful healthcare technology products with a collaborative engineering team. A culture that values ownership, continuous learning, and delivering high-quality software. Important This is a full-time, permanent payroll position in Türkiye. Candidates must have the right to work in Türkiye. As a physician-founded and led organization, ensuring everyone has access to quality healthcare is what inspires us. The magic we’ve created lies in Carbon Health’s custom EHR and the collaboration among clinical teams, engineers, and designers who work side-by-side to deliver innovation like our hands free AI charting tool. That’s why we hire people who genuinely care about patients, solving healthcare challenges, and making a positive impact every day. Join us and help change the future of healthcare for the better.

title: Backend Engineer (Java / Spring Boot)
description: About SoftZen SoftZen develops digital products and platforms for businesses operating in demanding, high-volume environments. Our teams build scalable web and mobile applications, cloud-based services, and intuitive user experiences. We are growing our backend engineering team to develop reliable systems that process large volumes of transactions and calculation-intensive business workflows. The Role We are looking for a Backend Engineer with strong Java and Spring Boot experience. You will build and evolve backend services where correctness, performance, scalability, and data integrity are critical. The systems you work on process high transaction volumes, manage concurrent requests, and execute calculation-heavy business logic. This is a hands-on engineering role. You will work closely with product, frontend, QA, and DevOps colleagues to deliver well-designed services that perform reliably in production. What You Will Do * Design, build, test, and maintain scalable backend services using Java and Spring Boot. * Develop RESTful APIs and microservices that support high-traffic, transaction-heavy applications. * Implement robust business and calculation logic with a strong focus on accuracy, consistency, and auditability. * Design reliable workflows for concurrent requests, failures, retries, and service-to-service communication. * Work with relational databases and transactional data to ensure reliable data processing. * Identify, investigate, and resolve performance bottlenecks, production incidents, and scalability issues. * Collaborate with DevOps on cloud deployments, CI/CD pipelines, monitoring, and operational reliability. * Participate in code reviews, technical design discussions, and continuous improvement of engineering practices. * Produce clean, maintainable, well-tested, and documented code. What We Are Looking For Required * At least 3 years of professional backend development experience. * Strong practical experience with Java and Spring Boot. * Experience developing RESTful APIs and backend services in a production environment. * Experience building systems that process high transaction volumes, concurrent requests, or calculation-intensive logic. * Solid understanding of data consistency, transactional processing, error handling, logging, and debugging. * Experience with relational databases and SQL. * Experience with AWS services, such as ECS, Lambda, S3, or similar cloud services. * Experience working with Docker and containerized applications. * Understanding of microservices architecture and distributed-system principles. * Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. * Ability to communicate clearly and work effectively in a cross-functional team. Preferred * Experience with Node.js. * Experience working with Kubernetes-based environments. * Experience with asynchronous or event-driven architectures. * Experience with CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, and code-quality tools. * Experience with monitoring and observability tools. * Experience in high-throughput domains, including payments, financial systems, gaming, real-time platforms, or similar transaction-sensitive products. What Success Looks Like * Backend services remain accurate and reliable under high traffic and concurrent usage. * Transactional and calculation logic is robust, testable, and traceable. * Performance and operational issues are identified and resolved effectively. * Code quality, test coverage, and technical documentation improve over time. * You contribute constructively to technical decisions and team delivery.

title: Full Stack Developer
description: KIPCO Grubu'nun (Kuwait Projects Company) bir iştiraki olarak 1977 yılında kurulan Burgan Bank Grubu, MENAT (Orta Doğu&Kuzey Afrika, Türkiye) bölgesinin en büyük şube ağına sahip bankalarından biridir. Özellikle kurumsal müşterilere, finansal kurumlara ve özel bankacılığa odaklanmış olup bireysel ve özel bankacılık alanlarında büyüyen bir markadır. 2013 yılından bu yana Burgan Bank Türkiye olarak sürekli değişen ve gelişen dünyanın dinamik yapısına hızla ayak uyduruyor, yenilikleri fırsata dönüştürüyoruz. Her zaman güvene dayalı, samimi ve sürdürülebilir ilişkiler kurarak tecrübeleri ve uzmanlıklarıyla birbirini besleyen ‘biz olmak, dinamizm ve kazanmak’ değerleri doğrultusunda uyum içinde çalışan bir kurumuz. Hedefe ulaşırken tüm ekip arkadaşlarımızın çabasını ve performansını güçlendirmek için çalışan mutluluğunu benimsiyoruz. Ailemizin her üyesine daha ilk günden itibaren “Burgan seninle” mesajını veriyor; kariyer, gelişim, gelecek ve yaşam yolculuğunda her türlü eğitim, seminer ve uygulamalarla Burganlılara destek oluyoruz. Bilgi Teknolojileri Grubu, Ödeme Sistemleri Geliştirme Bölümü, Kart ,Kampanya ve Ödemeler ekiplerimizde bankacılıkta fark yaratarak, müşterilerimize en iyi bankacılık deneyimini sunmak için çalışıyoruz. Agile ve çevik yaklaşımlarla, sadece kod yazmıyor, aynı zamanda geleceği şekillendiriyoruz. Eğer sen de bu heyecan verici yolculuğa katılmak istiyorsan başvurularınızı bekliyoruz ! Nasıl Yapıyoruz? SOLID Prensipleri: Temiz kod ve sürdürülebilir projeler için SOLID prensiplerini benimsiyoruz. .Net Core: Backend geliştirmelerimizde en güncel .Net Core versiyonlarını dapr destekli kullanıyoruz, N8N & Zeebe gibi araçlarla entegrasyon sağlıyoruz Veritabanı Teknolojileri: MSSQL, Qlik, ClickHouse, PostgreSQL kullanıyor ve Entity Framework ile ORM geliştirmeleri yapıyoruz.Redis, Kafka, RabbitMQ: Veri erişimi için Redis, event streaming için Kafka ve RabbitMQ kullanıyoruz. Openshift: Üretim ortamında container teknolojisi ile Openshift altyapısını kullanıyoruz. Azure DevOps: CI/CD süreçlerimizi Azure DevOps ile yönetiyor, zero downtime deployment ile süreçleri hızlandırıyoruz. Elastic Stack: Loglama ve performans yönetiminde Elastic Stack ile hayatımızı kolaylaştırıyoruz. Kimi Arıyoruz? 5 yıl veya üzeri yazılım geliştirme deneyimi Tercihen Kredi Kartı, Ödeme Sistemleri (Para Transferleri), Kampanya Yönetimi vb. alanların bir veya bir kaçında.Net Core ve Micro Service konularında yetkin DDD, Clean Architecture ve Yazılım Mimarileri konusunda karar alabilecek Agile ve Scrum metodolojilerine aşina Takım çalışmasına yatkın ve iletişim becerileri kuvvetli Ne Sunuyoruz? Zero Downtime: Azure DevOps ile zero downtime deployment yapıyoruz. Mimari Tasarım: Mevcut ve yeni projelerde senin fikirlerinle büyümek istiyoruz. Sen de projelerimize mimari açıdan yön vereceksin. Karar Verici: Sadece kod yazmakla kalmayacak, projelerin yönünü de belirleyeceksin. Kendini Geliştir: Yukarıda bahsedilen ve daha fazla teknolojiyle kendini geliştirme fırsatı seni bekliyor. Dilediğinde ofiste, dilediğinde uzaktan çalışmanı destekliyoruz. *** Burgan Bank Teknoloji ekibini daha yakından tanımak isterseniz aşağıdaki linke tıklayabilirsiniz. https://anlatsin.com/burgan-bank-bilgi-teknolojileri #burganseninle Başvurunuz nedeni ile paylaşmış olduğunuz kişisel veriler 6698 sayılı Kişisel Verilerin Korunması Kanunu (“KVKK”) kapsamında işlenmekte ve korunmaktadır. KVKK kapsamında işlenen kişisel verilerinize ilişkin detaylı bilgilendirmeye aşağıdaki bağlantıda yer alan aydınlatma metnimizden ulaşabilirsiniz. https://www.burgan.com.tr/calisan-adaylarina-ait-kisisel-verilerin-%C4%B0slenmesi-hakkinda-aydinlatma-metni

title: Mobile Application Developer – React Native
description: About Rigicon Rigicon is a global medical device company specializing in prosthetic and pelvic urology solutions, with operations across North America, EMEA, Latin America and Asia Pacific. Today that reaches patients in 70 countries We are Prosthetic Urology. Our vision is to be a trusted scientific partner in changing the practice of prosthetic urology. We're exclusively focused on designing, manufacturing, and marketing innovative prosthetic urology solutions, including inflatable and malleable penile implants, that restore function and quality of life for patients living with erectile dysfunction and other urological conditions. We work closely with surgeons and hospital systems: dedicated clinical support in the operating room, dependable product design, and a long-term commitment to advancing this field. Our mission is to offer a unique, comprehensive portfolio of products and services and keep high-quality, innovative prosthetic urology solutions accessible to every customer we serve. Job Description We are expanding our digital health product portfolio and looking for a React Native developer to own the mobile layer: architecture, implementation, testing, release management and app store publication. Design input and backend support are provided in-house. This is a full-time, on-site role at our Kavacık-Beykoz office in Istanbul, 5 days a week. Responsibilities Build our iOS and Android applications with React Native and Expo, in TypeScript Establish and maintain the application architecture: navigation, state management, form validation and title: Backend Engineer (Digital Assets)
description: Design the future architecture of one of Europe's most innovative banking networks while empowering engineers to do their best work. Role Summary We are looking for a Senior Backend Engineer to help build the next generation of digital asset, tokenization, and distributed financial infrastructure capabilities within ING. You will design and develop scalable backend services, APIs, integration layers, event-driven applications, and cloud-native platforms that support emerging digital asset and distributed ledger initiatives. While prior blockchain experience is welcome, it is not required. We are primarily looking for strong software engineers who are passionate about building resilient, secure, and high-performing distributed systems and are interested in expanding into the blockchain and digital assets domain. Work Model At ING Hubs Türkiye, flexibility is more than a benefit—it's part of how we work. Our hybrid way of working is designed to balance collaboration, innovation, and personal flexibility. Team members typically come together at our Vadistanbul office for two days per week during three weeks of the month, while one week each month is fully remote. We also provide additional flexibility throughout August with remote working opportunities, allowing colleagues to remain productive while staying connected with their teams. As part of a globally distributed organization, you'll collaborate with colleagues across multiple ING locations and contribute to solutions used across the bank. About the Team You will join an international technology organization where ownership, knowledge sharing, collaboration, and engineering excellence are at the heart of everything we do. Our teams design and deliver critical technology platforms that support ING's digital transformation journey. We believe scalable architectures, strong engineering practices, automation, and continuous learning are essential for delivering reliable solutions at scale. About You Minimum Qualifications 5+ years of experience in software engineering, solution design, or architecture roles Strong stakeholder management experience across business and technology domains Excellent communication and presentation skills Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities Experience working in Agile organizations Bachelor's degree in Computer Engineering, Software Engineering, or a related discipline Fluent English communication skills (C1 level or above) Technical Skills Strong experience in: Java (preferred) Kotlin Spring Boot REST APIs Microservices Architecture Experience with: Event-driven architectures Kafka RabbitMQ or similar messaging technologies SQL and NoSQL databases Containerization (Docker) Kubernetes CI/CD pipelines Git-based development workflows Good understanding of: Distributed systems System integration API design Scalability patterns Roles and Responsibilities Backend Engineering & Platform Development Design, build, and operate scalable backend services and APIs. Develop microservice-based applications running on cloud-native platforms. Create robust integration solutions between internal banking systems and emerging digital asset platforms. Build highly available, secure, and resilient services handling financial transactions and business-critical processes. Participate in architecture discussions covering scalability, performance, security, reliability, and maintainability. Distributed Systems & Digital Assets Support the design and implementation of distributed financial platforms. Contribute to digital asset, tokenization, and blockchain-related initiatives. Work on transaction workflows, settlement processes, custody integrations, and digital asset servicing capabilities. Learn and apply distributed ledger technologies where appropriate. Collaborate with blockchain engineers and architects on selected use cases. Engineering Excellence Build automated testing frameworks and CI/CD pipelines. Apply clean code principles and software craftsmanship practices. Improve observability, monitoring, logging, and operational resilience. Support production environments and participate in incident resolution activities. Contribute to reusable engineering patterns and platform capabilities. Security & Compliance Implement security-by-design principles. Apply secure coding standards and software development best practices. Work closely with security, risk, and compliance teams. Ensure regulatory and internal control requirements are considered throughout solution delivery. Collaboration Work in Agile squads with Product Owners, Architects, Business Analysts, SREs, and Security Specialists. Collaborate with global ING engineering teams. Share knowledge and contribute to engineering communities, demos, and innovation initiatives. Equal Opportunity Don't meet every single requirement? Don't let that hold you back. Studies show many talented professionals hesitate to apply unless they meet every qualification. If you're excited about this role and believe you can make an impact, we'd love to hear from you. What We Offer at ING Hubs Türkiye At ING Hubs Türkiye, we believe that your work should be fulfilling in every way. We pay attention to even the smallest details to ensure that your experience is rewarding. Be Yourself, Be an ING'er Welcome Leave: Enjoy 14 days of welcome leave, even in your first year Self-driven career opportunities Challenging projects and continuous learning opportunities Flexible hybrid working model Remote working opportunities throughout August Training budget and Udemy partnership Global mobility and international career opportunities Comprehensive health insurance for you and your family Private Pension Plan Meal Card Transportation Allowance MultiSport Membership English Language Development Support Innovation culture powered by PACE methodology Regular communication activities and celebrations About ING With 65,000 employees and operations in approximately 40 countries, there is no shortage of opportunities for people with initiative who want to help people take a step ahead in life and in business. Do you want to work at the cutting edge of what's possible and at the same time ensure you work with integrity and hold the customer's interests at heart? Do you want to be surrounded by progressive, inspiring, diverse and supportive colleagues? Then there is no better place to invest your talents than at ING. Join us. Apply today.

description: Senior Full Stack Developer / Technical Lead Lokasyon: Kozyatağı / İstanbul Kurumsal iş çözümleri ve web tabanlı SaaS ürünleri geliştiren şirketimizde görev alacak; yalnızca yazılım geliştirme süreçlerinde değil, teknik kararların alınması, ekibin yönlendirilmesi ve müşteri ihtiyaçlarının teknik çözümlere dönüştürülmesi konularında da sorumluluk üstlenecek deneyimli bir Senior Full Stack Developer / Technical Lead arıyoruz. title: React Frontend Developer — Kurucu Ekip (ilk etapta maaş yok, hisse var)
company: Assisto Bilişim Sanayi Ticaret Ltd Şti
description: ‼️ LÜTFEN ÖNCE BUNU OKU — BU İLANI SONUNA KADAR OKUMADAN BAŞVURMA.‼️ Seni işe almıyoruz. Seninle yol yürümek istiyoruz. İstanbul merkezli, İTÜ Çekirdek'te yer alan bir teknoloji girişimiyiz. İşletmelerin hayatını gerçekten kolaylaştıran, piyasada henüz karşılığı olmayan bir ürün geliştiriyoruz: restoran ve franchise zincirlerinin bugün 10'dan fazla ayrı yazılımla POS, muhasebe, stok, personel, kurye, franchise yönetimi — dağınık ve pahalı şekilde yaptığı her şeyi, tek bir AI destekli platformda birleştiriyoruz. Ve bunu dışarıdan bakan biri olarak yapmıyoruz. Kurucumuz bu sektörde 4 yıl kendi franchise şubelerini işletti, 5 yıl danışmanlık yaptı; 500'den fazla marka, binlerce şube. Çözdüğümüz derdi masabaşında değil, sahada yaşayarak öğrendik. Nerede olduğumuzu net söyleyelim: Şirket kuruldu. Ürünün 9 ayda %70-75'i yazıldı (backend .NET üzerine kurulu), yol haritası net, çıkışa hazırlanıyoruz. Pazar hazır — henüz ürünü açmadan görüştüğümüz markalar "bunu ne zaman kullanabiliriz" diye soruyor. Şimdi bu ürünün kullanıcının eline değen yüzünü kuracak birini arıyoruz. Sadece kod yazan değil — kullanıcının ne hissedeceğini düşünen, vizyonu olan, ekiple birlikte büyümek isteyen biri. Restoran çalışanı bu ekranı günde 8 saat kullanacak; senin yazdığın arayüz onun işini kolaylaştıracak ya da zorlaştıracak. Ekip ve takvim Bu bir "tek kişilik hayal" değil — aktif bir ekibimiz şu anda çalışıyor ve ürünü hızla çıkışa taşıyor. Kurucu ekip tamamlandığında toplam 3 backend + 1 ai mühendisi + 3 frontend geliştirici olacağız. Sen bu çekirdek ekibin bir parçası olacaksın. ( şuan 2 adet frontend'ci arayışımız vardır ) Hedefimiz: ürünü Ocak ayında yayına almak. Yani teoride değil, sahaya çıkışın hemen öncesinde katılıyorsun. Backend .NET üzerinde ilerliyor, mimari oturmuş durumda; sen arayüz tarafını bu sağlam temelin üstüne kuracaksın. Pazar ve fırsat Rakamlarla konuşalım, çünkü bu iş rakamlarla ayakta duruyor: Türkiye'de hedeflediğimiz alan 350-370 bin işletmelik bir potansiyel — küçük bir niş değil, devasa ve gerçek bir pazar. Ürünü 15–20.000 TL bandında konumluyoruz ve ilk etapta 7.500 kullanıcı hedefliyoruz. Bu, yüksek ve her ay tekrar eden bir gelir demek. Müşteri talebi arka planda şimdiden hazırlanıyor — biz sahaya çıktığımızda ilk kullanıcılar bizi bekliyor olacak. Ürün teknik olarak çok sağlam kuruldu. Bu bir "bakalım tutar mı" denemesi değil; çıkışa hazır, ayakları yere basan bir iş. Kısacası: senin alacağın %2,5 , hayali bir pazarın değil, talebi şimdiden oluşmuş gerçek bir işin payı. Önce şunu net söyleyelim Verebileceğimiz sabit bir maaş yok. Bu bir eksiklik değil — bilinçli bir tercih. Para bizim için amaç değil, sonuç. Doğru ürünü, doğru ekiple inşa ettiğimizde para zaten gelecek. Herkes projeden pay alarak çalışıyor. Biz büyüdükçe sen de büyüyorsun. Somut olalım: sana %2,5 kurucu ekip hissesi veriyoruz — yazılı hissedarlık sözleşmesi ve vesting ile (zamanla hak edişli, güvence altında). Gelir gelmeye başladığında ve/veya yatırım aldığımızda maaşa geçiş planı da sözleşmede yazılı olacak. Sözlü vaat yok, kağıt var. Başka bir işte çalışıyor olman sorun değil. Önemli olan vizyon ortaklığı, kalite ve teslimat. İstanbul'da ikamet ediyor olman bizim için artı ekipçe zaman zaman yüz yüze olmak işi ve iletişimi hızlandırıyor. Bu modeli okuyunca içinden "mantıklı" diyorsan — devam et. "Olmaz" diyorsan — zaman kaybetme, saygıyla. Teknik olarak ne arıyoruz? Arayüz tarafında React kullanıyoruz. Şunları biliyor ya da öğrenmeye kararlı olmalısın: React'te üretim seviyesinde deneyim — demoda kalmayan, gerçek kullanıcıya çıkmış işler Sağlam state yönetimi (Redux Toolkit / Zustand / Context + React Query — hangisine hakimsen) REST API entegrasyonu — backend'in .NET API'leriyle temiz, güvenli iletişim Responsive ve tutarlı UI; temiz, yeniden kullanılabilir komponent mimarisi JWT tabanlı auth akışlarını arayüzde doğru yönetmek Gerçek zamanlı deneyim (SignalR / WebSocket) — üründe aktif kullanıyoruz Offline-first / yerel önbellek (POS ekranı internet kesilince de çalışmalı) Tasarım sistemine hakimiyet; ölçeklenebilir tema ve komponent yapısı Akıcı animasyon ve mikro-etkileşimlerle iyi bir kullanıcı hissi Web öncelikli; masaüstü/mobil deneyim artı CI/CD, otomatik build/dağıtım (Vercel, GitHub Actions vb.) Yapay zekayı aktif olarak iş akışına entegre eden biri — kod üretmek, problem çözmek, hızlanmak. "Duydum" diyen değil, kullanan. Ne sunuyoruz? %2 kurucu ekip hissesi. Ürün büyüdükçe payının değeri büyür. Talebi şimdiden oluşmuş bir üründe erken giren kişi olmanın karşılığı. Yaptığın arayüz havada kalmıyor. Gerçek kullanıcıya çıkıyor, sahada her gün kullanılıyor. Gerçek söz hakkı. Ürünün nasıl görüneceğine, nasıl hissettireceğine sen de karar veriyorsun. Kullanıcı deneyiminin sahibi sensin. Uzun vadeli birliktelik. Bu kısa bir sprint değil; lansman sonrası da beraber büyütüyoruz. Sen kimsin? Vizyoner birisin — sadece bugünün işini değil, nereye gittiğimizi görerek çalışıyorsun Startup mantığını biliyorsun ya da benimsemeye açıksın — hız, belirsizlik, sahiplenme Kullanıcıyı düşünüyorsun; "çalışıyor" ile "iyi çalışıyor" arasındaki farkı önemsiyorsun Ekip çalışmasına yatkınsın, iletişime açıksın Bu işi kendi işin gibi sahiplenebilen birisin Yapay zekayı günlük iş akışında aktif kullanıyorsun — bu bizim için zorunlu GitHub'ında, App Store/Play Store'da ya da production'da duran, arkasında durduğun bir işin var Yönlendirilmeyi değil, birlikte üretmeyi seviyorsun Belirsizlikle barışıksın — startup gerçekçiliğini sindirebiliyorsun "Sadece ekran yazmıyorsun. Binlerce şubede her gün açılacak bir ürünün yüzünü kuruyorsun. Fikir aşamasından lansmanına kadar her adımda ekibin var — para hedefimiz değil, doğru işi yapmanın sonucu."
